purpose: Teach: やれる/切符/通す/光る/盛り上がる/不公平/仕上がり/固い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、何でも、絶対、やれる、絶対、つもりだったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When Dad was young, he really meant it — he thought he could do absolutely anything.
lines.style: Soft opening, like stepping into an old memory. Warm nostalgic tone, unhurried. Gentle certainty in the voice, as if the memory is both distant and vivid. Slight pause before 'remember,' checking that she's still with him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、汽車の、絶対、切符、絶対、買ってくださったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I remember, dear. When Grandpa was young, he really meant it — he'd buy train tickets for us without a second thought.
lines.style: Tender agreement from the start. Slightly dreamy quality, reaching back through time. Warm toward him, affectionate in the 'dear.' Soft landing on the memory, not performing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、お話を、絶対、通す、絶対、役だったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, you'd really stand up for what Dad said. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. Searching her face with his voice. The admiration is there but understated. Slower pace, as if he's testing whether the memory lands the same way for her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、夜空の、絶対、お星様、絶対、光る、絶対、と、絶対、お喜びだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When Grandpa was young, he was so delighted by the stars lighting up the night sky, remember, dear?
lines.style: Bright nostalgia, but grounded. A small smile in the voice. Genuine wonder at the memory of his wonder. Addresses him directly with 'dear,' keeping the moment intimate between them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お祭り、絶対、盛り上がる、絶対、と、絶対、嬉しかったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, you really came alive at the festivals — you were so happy then.
lines.style: A touch of wistfulness mixed with warmth. Lingering slightly on 'alive' and 'happy,' savoring the image. Slow, conversational pace. His affection is quiet but unmistakable.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、不公平、絶対、を、絶対、許せない、絶対、人、絶対、だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When Grandpa was young, he was someone who couldn't tolerate unfairness — you remember that about him, don't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective quality. Respectful weight to her words. Speaking with the certainty of someone who lived alongside that principle. Warm but dignified, not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、仕上がり、絶対、ほめてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, you always praised my cooking — you really meant it, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle vulnerability beneath the gratitude. A moment of transparency — he's sharing something that mattered to him. Soft, honest tone. Slight lift at the end, like he's checking if she remembers the same warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、決意の、絶対、固い、絶対、人、絶対、だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When Grandpa was young, he was someone with real conviction — such a firm resolve, remember, dear?
lines.style: Quiet pride in the memory. Speaking of him with reverence but without performance. Slow, measured delivery. The affection for him and for Hiroshi both live in her voice.
